definition.goal_policy: all_assumed: verified 90 where known, registered final otherwise; every score admitted
definition.elo_selection: minimum pooled non-friendly log loss; candidate eligible if paired excess <= one paired SE
definition.paired_se: standard deviation of 400 paired bootstrap differences, whole calendar quarters, seed 20261012
definition.model_adoption: non-friendly paired log-loss upper 95% CI < 0; mean Brier difference <= 0; at least 3/4 blocks improve
definition.model_tie_break: smallest feature/model complexity among passing models within one paired SE of best
definition.training: all earlier valid outcomes, both team orders; Elo state all available historical dates
definition.calibration: native probabilities; no post-hoc outcome calibration for count models, preserving score/1X2 coherence

sensitivities.exclude_marked: omit shootout or proven ET from count/form history, train and evaluation; retain all for Elo
sensitivities.non_friendlies: fit count models on all prior non-friendlies, evaluate separately
sensitivities.strict_worldcup: evaluate main count-model predictions on independently verified World Cup rows; not an alternative fitting population

definition.form_admission: approved all-assumed duration group; repeat against selected fixed-venue Elo and excluding marked history
definition.secondary_features: repeat individual ablations vs Elo + free venue; report, do not silently add new groups
definition.symmetry: predict both role orders, reconcile; count rates use one shared oriented regressor; tolerance 1e-9
definition.score_nll: infinite-support joint likelihood, optional bounded Dixon-Coles correction
definition.rho_validity: per-match clamp to positive low-score cell bounds; report activation
definition.score_model_selection: minimum non-friendly score NLL among passing count candidates; if none pass, descriptive score model only
